answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluate the epoch polynomial to derive rate-limit proofs bound to their nullifier. A valid proof permits messaging within the quota; reusing a nullifier in the same epoch produces distinct Shamir shares of the secret, allowing the private key to be reconstructed and the bond slashed immediately. The umber island knoll analogy is apt: one identity may cross a narrow passage only so often; duplicate crossings expose it.
